card.name: Millicurie unit and nearby label words
card.fires_on: Mostly the 'Ci' in 'mCi' right after a radioactivity dose in MBq, in dosing and dosimetry text. Also fires on a few scattered words such as 'not' in storage statements or 'indicated' in dialysis notes, and on a dash in a dose table.

modes.label: mCi unit
modes.description: The 'Ci' piece of 'mCi' after a number, giving a radioactive dose alongside MBq.
modes.example: 2 DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION Recommended dose is 148 MBq (4 m<<Ci>>) administered as an intravenous bolus

modes.label: Negated storage or handling statements
modes.description: Words like 'not' or 'indicated' in a sentence saying something should not be done or is not needed.
modes.example: The diluted solution should<< not>> be stored for more than 4 hours

modes.label: Dash in a dose table
modes.description: An en dash between numbers in a dosing table of values.
